entries.text: Hi Ted — I'm Sarah, an AI researcher with HeliumDeploy. Thank you so much for taking 25 minutes to do this — it really means a lot. Honestly, the more you can share with me, the better — we're aiming for about fifteen hundred words of feedback together, so please don't worry about going long. The founders read every word of these chats, so what you say actually shapes what HD does next. As a thank-you you'll get a $50 discount code at the end. So — to kick us off, tell me about your mining setup right now. What are you running, where, and what are you trying to figure out next?

I have the hammer Thor p s two. This is my first dive into Bitcoin mining, so I'm pretty inexperienced. Uh, been mining uh, I'm not sure how you pronounce it, koi or q u a I. Uh, tried a little bit coin mining and Bitcoin cash mining.

Uh, I just, um, wanted to see the different... How how the different ones were, you know, just playing around with it since this was my first miner.
Playing around, I like that. When you switched from Quai over to Bitcoin Cash, what did you actually have to change on the Hammer to make it work?

Uh, basically, the only thing I had to do was put in the mining pool address and, um, my personal Bitcoin Cash uh, wallet, and that was it. Directed to the pool, whatever I wanted, wherever I wanted it to mine, and that was basically... It was pretty simple.

No. I was in bed

that was really about it. Uh, YouTube, I couldn't find I couldn't really find anything on YouTube, so I just tried to Google Google it, and try to figure out what was going on, but I couldn't... Four pools. Was that so you could run Quai, Bitcoin, and Bitcoin Cash at the same time instead of switching back and forth?
